description: A known hypersensitivity, coded in a G-Standaard subsystem Prescriptor routes.

element.comment: Required by the base R4 invariant ait-1 whenever verificationStatus is not entered-in-error, and not read by fhir-hub.
The first coding in a routed system wins; codings in other systems are ignored. A resource with no routed coding at all is a 400.
Mandatory in base R4 and not read by fhir-hub. Send a data-absent-reason of 'unknown' if you have nothing to reference.
